critical.issue: 500 AttributeError: 'BiometricDeviceCreate' object has no attribute 'brand'. The Pydantic model was missing the 'brand' field but the handler read payload.brand (biometric_devices.py L1336). Multi-brand feature was completely broken — every device registration returned 500. FIXED by adding brand: Optional[str] = None to BiometricDeviceCreate model. Verified with pytest after backend restart.

critical_code_review_comments: biometric_devices.py L1336 reads payload.brand while the Pydantic schema at L41 did not declare it. Any usage of a Pydantic model attribute must be backed by a declared field — this could not have worked once at any point without the schema fix. Suggest adding a unit test that instantiates the model with brand='matrix' to prevent regression.

rca_of_issue: RCA — 500 on POST /api/biometric/devices: When the Iter 294 multi-brand feature was added, the handler was updated to read payload.brand + persist device['brand'], but the BiometricDeviceCreate Pydantic model was not updated. Pydantic v2 rejects attribute access for undeclared fields with AttributeError, resulting in FastAPI returning 500 Internal Server Error to any registration call — regardless of whether the client sent brand or not. Reproduction: POST /api/biometric/devices with any valid body → 500. Mitigation: add 'brand: Optional[str] = None' to BiometricDeviceCreate (applied). Verified by re-running TestBiometric class → 6/6 pass, device gets brand='matrix' persisted and webhook_key issued.
